definitions.full: H2782. charats I. חָרַץ verb cut, sharpen, decide (Late Hebrew id., cut in, decide , Aramaic in derivatives; Assyrian —arâƒu , dig, decide, —ariƒu , trench , Zehnpf BAS i. 502 ; Phoenician חרץ decision , Hoffm AGG xxxvi, May 1889, 11 ) — Qal Perfect 3masculine singular ׳ח Josh 10:21 ; חָרָ֑צְתָּ 1Kin 20:40 ; Imperfect יֶחֱרַץֿ Exod 11:7 ; 2 masculine singular תֶּחֱרָ֑ץ 2Sam 5:24 ; Passive participle חָרוּץ Isa 10:22 ; Lev 22:22 ; plural חֲרוּצִים Job 14:5 (see also חָרוּץ below); — 1 cut, mutilate Lev 22:22 ( יַבֶּלֶת אוֺ אוֺחָֿרוּץ שָׁבוּר אוֺ עַוֶּרֶת ). 2 sharpen , figurative the tongue, יֶח לְ׳לֹא לְשֹׁנוֺ כֶּֿלֶב Exod 11:7 (J), i.e. utter no sound against Israel, Josh 10:21 . 3 decide 1Kin 20:40 (absolute); so participle pass ימיו חרוצים Job 14:5 his days are determined, fixed (|| חדשׁיו מִסְמַּר ), Isa 10:22 ח ׳כִּלָּיוֺן ; act with decision 2Sam 5:24 . Niph`al Participle נֶחֱרָצָה Isa 10:23 3 t.; נֶחֱרֶצֶת Dan 9:26 (both these forms infinitive construct according to Ba NB 90 ); decisive וְנֶח ׳כָּלָה Isa 10:23 ; 28:22 ; Dan 9:27 a consumption and strict decision (i.e. that which is strictly determined), נ ׳כי נֶעֱשָׂ֑תָה 11:36 ; ׳נח שֹׁמֵמוֺת 9:26 strict determining of desolation .
